Messages.Author: Xexyz
Messages.Body:
The text of Cry Wolf states, "This werewolf must enter combat with any
minion controlled by another Methuselah as a (D) action." Does this
mean that if he becomes untapped during a minion phase in which he's
already used his rush to attack a minion, he's then stuck and can take
no other actions? Or does the "Must enter combat..." text only need
to be satisfied once per minion phase, meaning if he becomes untapped
he's free to take other actions?
